# Live prompt-eval CI job scores coverage 0.0 on every spec

## Context / Problem

`.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml`'s `eval-live` job calls `ev.run_eval(pid, max_cases=cap)`
directly (`.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml:136`) with no gate session and no
`REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED`. Every agentic finder run therefore reaches
`assert_gated` (`src/rebar/llm/runner.py:374` -> `src/rebar/llm/gate_context.py:137`) and raises
"agentic filesystem tools was attempted OUTSIDE the repo-snapshot gate process". `run_eval`
records a solver exception as an UNSCORED case (`src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py:673`), so each spec
reports `coverage = 0.0`, and the job (`continue-on-error: true`, `:95`) only emits an advisory
`::warning::` (`:143`). A total scoring failure is indistinguishable from an ordinary regression.

The sibling entry point `calibrate_criterion` (`src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py:384`, used by
`rebar criteria eval`, which the same workflow runs at `prompt-eval.yml:72`) has the same defect:
measured offline 2026-11-17 at origin/main 05c6414358f, a `solve` that calls `assert_gated`
raises `RuntimeError` out of `calibrate_criterion("G7", solve=...)`.

## Reproduction (measured)

- Full dataset, worktree at origin/main 0e7401446c58: `ev.run_eval('code-review-tests')` ->
  `coverage=0.0 epoch_pass=[false,false,false]` in 40 s; all 117 case-runs carry the gate error.
- Offline, origin/main 05c6414358f: `run_eval('plan-review-g7', solve=<solve calling
  assert_gated>, max_cases=3)` -> `coverage 0.0`; the same call inside
  `gate_source.gate_read_root(resolve_gate_handle(None, SOURCE_LOCAL, None, fetch=False))` ->
  `coverage 1.0`.

## Approach

Make both eval entry points establish the gate session themselves, in-process, so every caller
(the CI step, the CLI, a project on another CI provider or none) gets it. The eval deliberately
evaluates the DIRTY working tree (`run_eval` docstring), so the explicit source mode is
`SOURCE_LOCAL`, which is exactly what `gate_source.gate_read_root`
(`src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py:189`) marks as a deliberate local gate session. This reuses the
existing gate seam already used by `fixture_mining/heal.py:435` and `provider_parity.py:355`.

1. In `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py`, add one private context manager `_eval_gate_session(repo_root)`
   that resolves `gate_source.resolve_gate_handle(None, gate_source.SOURCE_LOCAL, repo_root,
   fetch=False)` and enters `gate_source.gate_read_root(handle)`.
2. Wrap the case loop of `run_eval` and of `calibrate_criterion` (including default-solver
   construction) in it.
3. `run_eval` returns two new keys: `errored` (count of case-runs that raised) and
   `run_failure` (True iff any epoch scored zero of its non-empty dataset).
4. The `eval-live` step collects specs with `run_failure`, prints a `::error::` line naming them,
   and exits non-zero after writing all JUnit files; ordinary regressions stay a `::warning::`.

No config key, env var or flag is added; `REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED` is not used.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py` — gate-session helper, both entry points, `run_failure`/`errored`.
- `.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml` — report `run_failure` specs as an error.
- `tests/unit/test_eval.py` — regression tests.
- `docs/workflow-engine.md` — one sentence on the run-failure report in the live-eval paragraph
  (`docs/workflow-engine.md:186`).

Portability: the change uses a `contextvars` gate marker and the local-mode handle
(`Path.resolve()` of the checkout); no subprocess, file descriptor, signal or POSIX path API.

## Testing

Offline, with an injected `solve` that calls `assert_gated` and `REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED`
removed via `monkeypatch.delenv`:
- happy path: `run_eval` returns `coverage > 0`, `run_failure False`, `errored 0`;
  `calibrate_criterion` returns a report;
- failure path: calling that `solve` directly outside the entry point raises `RuntimeError`, and
  a `solve` that always raises gives `coverage 0.0`, `run_failure True`, `errored == epochs * cases`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The `eval-live` job's live step runs `run_eval` inside a gate session whose source mode is
      chosen explicitly (`SOURCE_LOCAL` inside `run_eval`), not the configured default.
      `REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED` is NOT used. Checked by reading `eval.py` and `prompt-eval.yml`.
- [x] A regression test in `tests/unit/test_eval.py` asserts that with the safeguard active and
      no override set, `run_eval` completes with `coverage > 0` against an injected offline
      `solve` that calls `assert_gated`, and that the same `solve` called outside raises. The test
      fails against origin/main 05c6414358f (checked by running it there).
- [x] `calibrate_criterion` runs its cases inside the same gate session; a regression test with
      a gated `solve` returns a report instead of raising.
- [x] `run_eval` distinguishes "every case errored" from "cases scored and failed": a 0.0-coverage
      epoch sets `run_failure: True`, and the `eval-live` step reports it as `::error::` and
      exits non-zero rather than as the advisory warning. Checked by a unit test and by reading
      the workflow.
- [x] The portability constraint holds: the gate-session requirement is enforced in-process (in
      `eval.py`), not by a GitHub-Actions-only step.
- [x] `make verify` exits 0.
